verses.text: 'I have made a covenant with my eyes; How then could I gaze at a virgin?
verses.textZh: 我與眼睛立約，怎能戀戀瞻望處女呢？

verses.text: 'And what is the portion of God from above Or the heritage of the Almighty from on high?
verses.textZh: 從至上的神所得之分，從至高全能者所得之業是甚麼呢？

verses.text: 'Is it not calamity to the unjust And disaster to those who work iniquity?
verses.textZh: 豈不是禍患臨到不義的，災害臨到作孽的呢？

verses.text: 'Does He not see my ways And number all my steps?
verses.textZh: 神豈不是察看我的道路，數點我的腳步呢？

verses.text: 'If I have walked with falsehood, And my foot has hastened after deceit,
verses.textZh: 我若與虛謊同行，腳若追隨詭詐；

verses.text: Let Him weigh me with accurate scales, And let God know my integrity.
verses.textZh: （我若被公道的天平稱度，使神可以知道我的純正；）

verses.text: 'If my step has turned from the way, Or my heart followed my eyes, Or if any spot has stuck to my hands,
verses.textZh: 我的腳步若偏離正路，我的心若隨著我的眼目，若有玷污粘在我手上；

verses.text: Let me sow and another eat, And let my crops be uprooted.
verses.textZh: 就願我所種的有別人吃，我田所產的被拔出來。

verses.text: 'If my heart has been enticed by a woman, Or I have lurked at my neighbor's doorway,
verses.textZh: 我若受迷惑，向婦人起淫念，在鄰舍的門外蹲伏，

verses.text: May my wife grind for another, And let others kneel down over her.
verses.textZh: 就願我的妻子給別人推磨，別人也與他同室。

verses.text: 'For that would be a lustful crime; Moreover, it would be an iniquity [punishable by] judges.
verses.textZh: 因為這是大罪，是審判官當罰的罪孽。

verses.text: 'For it would be fire that consumes to Abaddon, And would uproot all my increase.
verses.textZh: 這本是火焚燒，直到毀滅，必拔除我所有的家產。

verses.text: 'If I have despised the claim of my male or female slaves When they filed a complaint against me,
verses.textZh: 我的僕婢與我爭辯的時候，我若藐視不聽他們的情節；

verses.text: What then could I do when God arises? And when He calls me to account, what will I answer Him?
verses.textZh: 神興起，我怎樣行呢？他察問，我怎樣回答呢？

verses.text: 'Did not He who made me in the womb make him, And the same one fashion us in the womb?
verses.textZh: 造我在腹中的，不也是造他麼？將他與我摶在腹中的豈不是一位麼？

verses.text: 'If I have kept the poor from [their] desire, Or have caused the eyes of the widow to fail,
verses.textZh: 我若不容貧寒人得其所願，或叫寡婦眼中失望，

verses.text: Or have eaten my morsel alone, And the orphan has not shared it
verses.textZh: 或獨自吃我一點食物，孤兒沒有與我同吃；

verses.text: (But from my youth he grew up with me as with a father, And from infancy I guided her),
verses.textZh: （從幼年時孤兒與我同長，好像父子一樣；我從出母腹就扶助寡婦。）

verses.text: If I have seen anyone perish for lack of clothing, Or that the needy had no covering,
verses.textZh: 我若見人因無衣死亡，或見窮乏人身無遮蓋；

verses.text: If his loins have not thanked me, And if he has not been warmed with the fleece of my sheep,
verses.textZh: 我若不使他因我羊的毛得暖，為我祝福；

verses.text: If I have lifted up my hand against the orphan, Because I saw I had support in the gate,
verses.textZh: 我若在城門口見有幫助我的，舉手攻擊孤兒；

verses.text: Let my shoulder fall from the socket, And my arm be broken off at the elbow.
verses.textZh: 情願我的肩頭從缺盆骨脫落，我的膀臂從羊矢骨折斷。

verses.text: 'For calamity from God is a terror to me, And because of His majesty I can do nothing.
verses.textZh: 因神降的災禍使我恐懼；因他的威嚴，我不能妄為。

verses.text: 'If I have put my confidence [in] gold, And called fine gold my trust,
verses.textZh: 我若以黃金為指望，對精金說：你是我的倚靠；

verses.text: If I have gloated because my wealth was great, And because my hand had secured [so] much;
verses.textZh: 我若因財物豐裕，因我手多得資財而歡喜；

verses.text: If I have looked at the sun when it shone Or the moon going in splendor,
verses.textZh: 我若見太陽發光，明月行在空中，

verses.text: And my heart became secretly enticed, And my hand threw a kiss from my mouth,
verses.textZh: 心就暗暗被引誘，口便親手；

verses.text: That too would have been an iniquity [calling for] judgment, For I would have denied God above.
verses.textZh: 這也是審判官當罰的罪孽，又是我背棄在上的神。

verses.text: 'Have I rejoiced at the extinction of my enemy, Or exulted when evil befell him?
verses.textZh: 我若見恨我的遭報就歡喜，見他遭災便高興；

verses.text: 'No, I have not allowed my mouth to sin By asking for his life in a curse.
verses.textZh: （我沒有容口犯罪，咒詛他的生命；）

verses.text: 'Have the men of my tent not said, 'Who can find one who has not been satisfied with his meat '?
verses.textZh: 若我帳棚的人未嘗說，誰不以主人的食物吃飽呢？

verses.text: 'The alien has not lodged outside, [For] I have opened my doors to the traveler.
verses.textZh: （從來我沒有容客旅在街上住宿，卻開門迎接行路的人；）

verses.text: 'Have I covered my transgressions like Adam, By hiding my iniquity in my bosom,
verses.textZh: 我若像亞當（或譯：別人）遮掩我的過犯，將罪孽藏在懷中；

verses.text: Because I feared the great multitude, And the contempt of families terrified me, And kept silent and did not go out of doors?
verses.textZh: 因懼怕大眾，又因宗族藐視我使我驚恐，以致閉口無言，杜門不出；

verses.text: 'Oh that I had one to hear me! Behold, here is my signature; Let the Almighty answer me! And the indictment which my adversary has written,
verses.textZh: 惟願有一位肯聽我！（看哪，在這裡有我所劃的押，願全能者回答我！）

verses.text: Surely I would carry it on my shoulder, I would bind it to myself like a crown.
verses.textZh: 願那敵我者所寫的狀詞在我這裡！我必帶在肩上，又綁在頭上為冠冕。

verses.text: 'I would declare to Him the number of my steps; Like a prince I would approach Him.
verses.textZh: 我必向他述說我腳步的數目，必如君王進到他面前。

verses.text: 'If my land cries out against me, And its furrows weep together;
verses.textZh: 我若奪取田地，這地向我喊冤，犁溝一同哭泣；

verses.text: If I have eaten its fruit without money, Or have caused its owners to lose their lives,
verses.textZh: 我若吃地的出產不給價值，或叫原主喪命；

verses.text: Let briars grow instead of wheat, And stinkweed instead of barley.' The words of Job are ended.
verses.textZh: 願這地長蒺藜代替麥子，長惡草代替大麥。約伯的話說完了。
